T: Hopps works hard, Wilde plays it cool.
D: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde chase a pit viper through Zootopia and turn up a century-old secret about who really built the city.
P: Serve the noodle worms when Jesús tells the partners to eat first.
S: Soy and sesame noodles that wriggle like worms. Noodle worms, says Jesús.

Whisk the soy, sesame oil, honey and garlic together. Cook the udon in boiling water until loose and tender, then drain. Toss the hot noodles in the sauce. Pile into small bowls and finish with spring onion and sesame seeds.
Chicken, leek and carrot pot pies, for crashing the Zootennial Gala.

Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leek and carrot and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick. Stir in the peas, season and spoon into 4 small ovenproof dishes. Top each with a round of pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Rest for 5 minutes and serve.
M: Crisp pizza straight from a hot tray, for Nick's Neighsayer 2 movie night.

Heat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside. Stretch the dough into 2 rounds and spread with sauce. Top with mozzarella, pepperoni, mushrooms and oregano. Bake on the hot tray until blistered and bubbling. Drizzle with oil and cut into slices.
Russ snaps up a fish at Marsh Market.

Stir the sour cream with the zest and juice of a lime. Whisk the flour, paprika, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a light batter. Dip the fish and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with cabbage and fish, add the crema and finish with coriander and lime.
500g firm white fish fillets, cut in strips@Seafood
W: Strawberry and honey ice blocks. Hoggbottom says go back to slinging pawpsicles.
Blend the strawberries with the honey and apple juice until smooth. Layer the strawberry mix and yoghurt in ice pop moulds, swirling with a skewer. Push in the sticks and freeze until solid.
K: Carrot, orange and ginger soda. A giant can from the ZPD machine.
Stir the carrot juice, orange juice, ginger and honey together. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses and top with soda.
